name: SegmentedControl
description: An iOS-style segmented control whose raised thumb springs between segments and squishes slightly while pressed. Hairline dividers fade around the active segment, with a neutral or solid accent thumb.
a11yNotes: Uses the WAI-ARIA radio group pattern: a role="radiogroup" with an accessible name (aria-label, or the visible caption via aria-labelledby) containing role="radio" buttons with aria-checked. Roving tabindex keeps one Tab stop; Arrow keys move and select with wrapping, Home/End jump to the first/last segment. Focus is shown with a 2px outline. Under prefers-reduced-motion the thumb jumps without spring or squish.

propsApi.name: options
propsApi.description: Segment labels; each label is also its value.

propsApi.name: defaultValue
propsApi.description: Initial selected value when uncontrolled (falls back to the second, then first option).

propsApi.name: onValueChange
propsApi.description: Called with the newly selected value.

propsApi.name: showLabel
propsApi.description: Render the label as a visible caption above the control.

propsApi.name: size
propsApi.description: Height, padding and type size preset.

propsApi.name: variant
propsApi.description: Raised neutral thumb (iOS look) or a solid accent thumb with white text.

propsApi.name: accentColor
propsApi.description: Thumb color of the accent variant.

propsApi.name: fullWidth
propsApi.description: Stretch the control to the container width with equal segments.

propsApi.name: stiffness
propsApi.description: Spring stiffness of the sliding thumb.

propsApi.name: className
propsApi.description: Additional class merged onto the root element.

propsApi.name: style
propsApi.description: Inline styles merged onto the root element.
